key_insight: FICE is the first fully inductive learned cardinality estimator for SPARQL basic graph patterns, generalizing to unseen graphs and relations without retraining.
engineering_relevance: It enables fast, sub-millisecond query optimization for real-world triplestores that must handle evolving knowledge graphs.
method: Encoder GNN learns entity and relation embeddings on a factor-graph view of the knowledge graph.
Decoder GNN composes those embeddings along the query join structure to predict log-cardinality.
Joint training with neighborhood sampling scales to multi-million-triple graphs.
evidence_signal: Across 10 knowledge graphs, FICE improved median q-error to 5.34 versus 13.54 for the best competitor and showed better tail performance.
watch_item: Performance depends on accurate local neighborhood aggregation, so scalability and quality may be sensitive to graph sparsity or noisy sampling choices.
